ResearchProjectDef.label: floating raft piece
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to increase the buoyancy of rafts.

ResearchProjectDef.label: rig I
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to build basic ship rigging including mast and sail assemblies to increase vessel speed, and construct crow's nests to spot islands, shipwrecks, and points of interest.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->harnessing the power of the wind with a sturdy mast and sails
subject_story->building high lookout perches to scout treacherous waters and distant lands

ResearchProjectDef.label: rig II
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to build advanced multi-tiered masts and complex sail rigs to dramatically increase the cruising speed of your ships.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->designed massive multi-tiered masts capable of holding extensive sail area
subject_story->perfected complex sail plans to catch even the faintest ocean breezes

ResearchProjectDef.label: outboard motor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to manufacture electrically powered outboard motors for watercraft, trading electrical power for steady and rapid propulsion regardless of wind.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->adapted microelectronics into a rugged, waterproof marine propulsion drive
subject_story->designed high-torque electric outboard engines to power vessels through calm waters

ResearchProjectDef.label: cannon
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn to cast and assemble black powder naval cannons to arm watercraft with devastating heavy firepower against enemy vessels and threats.

rulesStrings.li: subject_story->now we can cast heavy iron barrels designed to withstand gunpowder detonations
subject_story->designed powerful cannons on naval carriages to dominate maritime combat
